newsitem.title: USA: Alagasco says $17.1 mln refund approved.
newsitem.headline: Alagasco says $17.1 mln refund approved.

text.p: Alagasco said Wednesday that the Alabama Public Service Commission has approved a $17.1 million refund to its customers.

The commission also approved a five-year extension of its rate-setting methodology, which allows for quarterly adjustments designed to give Alagasco a chance to earn a return on equity within a specified range.

Alagasco customers will see a credit on their January bills as a result of the refund, which is part of a recent settlement on rate proceedings involving Alagasco's primary interstate supplier, Southern Natural Gas Co.
